text: Rust native tree sitter for DAX

P1 follow-up (from 074-S adversarial review, docs/closure/2026-07-05-notready-scope-fix-adversarial-review.md finding F1): the DaemonError::NotReady --direct escape-hatch hint (added in 073-S, kept for the startup path in 074-S) is STILL misleading in a startup-hydration-hang scenario. When a freshly-spawned daemon acquires DaemonLock (src/daemon/mod.rs:105, BEFORE reaching Ready) and then hangs during hydration, poll_until_ready times out and returns NotReady with the --direct hint — but 'engram index --direct' then fails with AlreadyHeld (src/cli/direct.rs:75-79) because the new daemon already holds the workspace lock. 074-S fixed the daemon-SHUTDOWN-wait path (new ShutdownTimeout variant); this is the remaining STARTUP-path sub-case. Options to weigh: (a) make the --direct hint conditional on whether DaemonLock is actually free/acquirable at the time of the timeout; (b) split NotReady into 'startup-before-lock' (hint valid) vs 'startup-after-lock-hydration-hang' (hint invalid, suggest stopping the pid instead); (c) soften the hint wording. Design decision for the operator. Low-severity (misleading hint in a rare hydration-hang path) but closes the misleading-hint class fully.
